method: Retain every existing question stem, option, keyed answer, and original explanation unchanged.
Add one teaching rationale for each of the four existing options.
Explain the decision rule or misconception rather than merely labeling an option wrong.
Check that the rationale for the keyed option remains consistent with the previously audited keyed answer.
Use no external practice-question wording or exam-item source when writing the rationales.
ci_invariant: CI evaluates legacy-rationales.js and fails unless Q-001 through Q-056 each have exactly four non-empty rationales.
